Subject: Annual performance cycle: timeline, sensitive routing & comms (privileged)

Team —

Closing the loop on the annual performance cycle plan I promised last week. Attached: cycle_timeline_v3.xlsx (master timeline), and a draft of sensitive_routing_guidelines.md for how we handle manager notes flagged as privileged or legally sensitive. High-level asks:

- Review the timeline (especially calibration windows) and confirm any blackout dates by EOD Friday.
- Agree on a safe path for routing sensitive manager comments and accommodation requests to Legal/People Ops without exposing them to wider calibration panels.
- Sign-off on the proposed manager training session cadence so we can lock rooms and vendors.

Key constraints: payroll freeze the week of 3/30, expected org-change announcements targeted for the week of 4/12, and we need calibration completed before any feedback goes live. We may need a brief exec-only calibration on 4/5 if org-change items surface.

Notes on attachments: the timeline has a private tab ("Privileged") that lists names and routing owners — treat that tab as confidential. PeopleOps Consulting is on the thread for the legal-compliance checklist.

Thanks — I want to finalize the plan by Friday so HR can publish manager materials on Monday.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, People Operations | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — quick items:

1) Calibration panel dates
I see the timeline has week-of-4/5 and week-of-4/12 for calibration. Can we tighten to 4/5–4/9 only and reserve 4/12 for communications to avoid overlapping with the public announcement? If org-change items push, we'll need an exec-only session the afternoon of 4/5.

2) Manager training
Propose a 90-minute mandatory training for managers (policy + calibration exercise). I suggest two live cohorts (APAC-friendly and US/EU-friendly) and one recorded session. That means vendor/room booking by 2/27.

3) Confidential routing
I want a clear step that manager submits privileged notes via People Ops form (not email). Does the attached sensitive_routing_guidelines.md include the form link? If not, let's add a DocuSign-style acknowledgement for receiving sensitive information.

I'll review the Privileged tab and send comments inline.

-Laura

Hi all —

Thanks for the context. A few concrete recommendations based on the attachments you sent:

1) Sensitive routing flow
- Use a People Ops intake form (link included in Drive) that writes to an encrypted bucket. Managers must select a category: Legal Escalation, Accommodation, Safety/Compliance. Items flagged "Legal Escalation" are routed to Legal and People Ops; everything else is People Ops-only.

2) Retention/Access
- Recommended retention for privileged manager notes: 7 years for Legal Escalation; 3 years for Accommodation (subject to local law). Access control: People Ops + Legal + the employee's manager.

3) Timeline adjustments
- Move one calibration cohort to 3/29 afternoon to accommodate product teams; keep a reserve exec-only on 4/5 afternoon.

4) DocuSign acknowledgement
- We can add a short manager attestation in the intake flow; that will be routed with the note and logged.

We've updated a copy of sensitive_routing_guidelines.md in Drive (v1.1) and added a sample intake form. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-cycle-2026

Regards,
Anjali Kapoor
Consultant, PeopleOps Consulting
contact@peopleops-consulting.com
